def test_build_install_symlink_round_trip(collection_input):
    input_dir, output_dir = collection_input
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(input_dir, 'playbooks', 'roles'))
    os.symlink(os.path.join(input_dir, 'roles', 'common'),
               os.path.join(input_dir, 'playbooks', 'roles', 'common'))
    os.symlink(os.path.join(input_dir, 'README.md'),
               os.path.join(input_dir, 'docs', 'README-link.md'))
    outside_file = os.path.join(output_dir, 'external.txt')
    with open(outside_file, 'w') as output:
        output.write('external content')
    os.symlink(outside_file, os.path.join(input_dir, 'docs', 'external.txt'))

    collection.build_collection(input_dir, output_dir, False)
    artifact = os.path.join(output_dir, 'ansible_namespace-collection-0.1.0.tar.gz')
    with tarfile.open(artifact) as tar:
        assert tar.getmember('docs/external.txt').isreg()
        assert tar.getmember('docs/README-link.md').issym()
        assert tar.getmember('playbooks/roles/common').issym()

    destination = os.path.join(output_dir, 'installed', 'namespace', 'collection')
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(destination))
    requirement = collection.CollectionRequirement.from_tar(to_bytes(artifact), False)
    requirement.install_artifact(to_bytes(destination), to_bytes(output_dir))
    assert os.path.islink(os.path.join(destination, 'docs', 'README-link.md'))
    assert os.path.islink(os.path.join(destination, 'playbooks', 'roles', 'common'))
    assert os.path.realpath(os.path.join(destination, 'docs', 'README-link.md')) == os.path.join(destination, 'README.md')
    with open(os.path.join(destination, 'docs', 'external.txt')) as installed:
        assert installed.read() == 'external content'

    assert not collection._is_child_path(os.path.join(root, 'link'), root, '../../outside')

def test_extract_tar_dir_rejects_escaping_parent_and_materializes_external_link(tmp_path):
    destination = str(tmp_path / 'collection')
    outside = str(tmp_path / 'outside')
    os.makedirs(destination)
    os.makedirs(outside)
    tar_path = str(tmp_path / 'links.tar')
    with tarfile.open(tar_path, 'w') as tar:
        info = tarfile.TarInfo('external')
        info.type = tarfile.SYMTYPE
        info.linkname = '../outside'
        tar.addfile(info)
        info = tarfile.TarInfo('parent/child')
        info.type = tarfile.DIRTYPE
        tar.addfile(info)
    with tarfile.open(tar_path) as tar:
        collection._extract_tar_dir(tar, 'external', to_bytes(destination))
        assert os.path.isdir(os.path.join(destination, 'external'))
        assert not os.path.islink(os.path.join(destination, 'external'))
        os.symlink(outside, os.path.join(destination, 'parent'))
        with pytest.raises(AnsibleError, match='outside the collection directory'):
            collection._extract_tar_dir(tar, 'parent/child', to_bytes(destination))
    assert not os.path.exists(os.path.join(outside, 'child'))
